metadata.subject: Algorithms
metadata.title: Discover Insertion Sort
metadata.description: Grow a sorted prefix by inserting each new value where it belongs.

learning_objectives: Insert the current value into its correct position.

mission.title: Insert into order
mission.description: Treat the left side like a sorted hand of cards and insert one value at a time.

introduction.title: Insertion Sort grows a sorted left side
introduction.content: Insertion Sort takes the next value, shifts larger values to the right, and inserts the value into the sorted space.
points: The first value is already a sorted prefix.
The sorted prefix grows after every insertion.

worked_example.title: Insert 30 like a card
worked_example.content: Compare the current value with the sorted prefix from right to left.

steps.explanation: 20 and 50 are the sorted prefix; 30 is the next value.
50 is larger than 30, so shift it one position right.
30 fits between 20 and 50, so the prefix is sorted again.

worked_example.conclusion: Each insertion keeps the left prefix sorted while the unsorted part shrinks.

next.title: Now grow the sorted prefix.
next.content: Advance one insertion at a time.

next-step: The next value is selected after the sorted prefix.
Larger prefix values shifted right to make room.
The current value was inserted into the sorted prefix.
Every value is now in ascending order.

prediction.heading: Before the next insertion…
prediction.question: Which value will be inserted into the sorted prefix next?
prediction.selection_message: Your prediction: {prediction}. Run the next insertion to check it.
prediction.pending_message: Predict the next value that will be inserted.
prediction.required_message: Choose the next value after the current sorted prefix.

result.actual: The next insertion takes value {actual} and places it into order.

actions.label: Select the next value
actions.task: Choose the next key after the sorted prefix.

actions.label: Shift larger values
actions.task: Compare from right to left and SHIFT a larger prefix value.

actions.label: Insert into the prefix
actions.task: INSERT the key in the open position that keeps the prefix sorted.

challenge.title: Insertion Sort challenge
challenge.start_message: Grow the sorted prefix by inserting each next value.
challenge.continue_message: Challenge complete. Keep practising card-style insertion.

phases.title: Sort the array
phases.instruction: Complete each insertion until the array is sorted.
phases.feedback: Shift only values larger than the current value, then insert it.

guidance.start_message: Watch the sorted prefix grow after each insertion.

items.content: Compare the selected value with the prefix from right to left.

phases.title: Practice the prefix
phases.instruction: Insert each next value until the array is sorted.
phases.feedback: The left prefix must be sorted after every insertion.

guidance.start_message: Apply the card-sorting idea without a hint.

phases.title: Apply insertion
phases.instruction: Sort this fresh array by repeated insertions.
phases.feedback: Shift larger prefix values right before inserting the current value.

constraints.operation_limit_message: All three insertions were used before the target was sorted.

guidance.start_message: Plan each insertion; one pass handles one next value.

phases.title: Solve in three insertions
phases.instruction: Reach the sorted target by inserting each next value.
phases.feedback: The sorted prefix grows by one position after each insertion.

phases.title: Master the sorted hand
phases.instruction: Use insertion decisions to sort the unfamiliar array.
phases.feedback: Insert each value after shifting only the larger values.

thinking.title: Predict the insertions
thinking.instruction: Mentally insert each value into the sorted prefix.
thinking.do_not_execute: Do not run the passes yet. Count each shift in your head.

prediction_fields.label: Final array
prediction_fields.prompt: What will the final sorted array contain?

prediction_fields.label: Total shifts
prediction_fields.prompt: How many larger values shift right in total?

feedback.all_correct: You traced every insertion and shift.
feedback.incorrect: Treat the left side as sorted and count each larger value moved right.

solve.title: Expert Insertion Sort
solve.instruction: Sort the unfamiliar array with no hints.
solve.perfect_result: Every value joined the sorted prefix in the correct pass.

quiz.question: What happens before the current value is inserted in Insertion Sort?

discovery.title: Insertion Sort discovery
discovery.summary: Insertion Sort maintains a sorted prefix by shifting larger values right and placing the next value into the gap.

sections.title: What?
sections.content: Insertion Sort grows a sorted prefix one value at a time.

sections.title: Example
sections.content: To insert 30 into [20, 50], shift 50 right and place 30 between them.

sections.title: Why?
sections.content: The prefix is already ordered, so only larger values need to move.

sections.title: Remember
sections.content: Take next value → shift larger cards → insert into the gap.

alternate_explanations.title: Think of playing cards
alternate_explanations.content: When a new card arrives, slide larger cards aside until the card fits in your hand.

alternate_explanations.title: Walk through it
alternate_explanations.content: Insert 10 into [5, 20]: shift 20 right, then place 10 to get [5, 10, 20].

recall.title: Recall
recall.prompt: In your own words, why are larger values shifted right during Insertion Sort?
recall.model_answer: They move right to create a gap where the current value can be inserted without breaking the sorted prefix.
